name: Victor Negrescu - Après le § 4 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 2/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 - Update of revenue (own resources) and adjustments to expenditure
part_text: 4 b. Considers that the adoption of “own resources” for the European Union, which smacks of federalist ulterior motives, would encourage the pursuit of irresponsible, reckless spending;
